def transform(grid):
    """Map the less frequent color to the more frequent color; map background to 0."""
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for x in row:
            counts[x] = counts.get(x, 0) + 1
    bg = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    mark = next((c for c in counts if c != bg), bg)
    return [[bg if x == mark else 0 for x in row] for row in grid]
PY
